class.name: GaussianSplatDebugHUD
class.brief_description: Internal "Route & residency HUD": route, policy and residency diagnostics drawn by a [GaussianSplatNode3D].
class.description: GaussianSplatDebugHUD is the internal "Route & residency HUD". It draws the diagnostic lines the linked [GaussianSplatRenderer] publishes (selected render, sort and cull route, requested policy, backend reason, splat counts, device boundaries, texture states and residency) directly in the viewport. It deliberately shows no frame rate, frame time or GPU pass timing. The one runtime performance overlay is [GaussianSplatPerformanceOverlay]. The HUD is created and managed by [GaussianSplatNode3D] when its debug HUD property is enabled. Use [member corner] to choose which viewport corner displays the overlay, [member update_interval] to control refresh frequency, and [member font_size] or [member background_color] to adjust visual presentation. The HUD automatically ignores mouse input so it does not interfere with scene interaction.

method.name: refresh_stats
method.description: Forces an immediate refresh of the displayed statistics, bypassing the normal [member update_interval] cadence.

members.member: Which corner of the viewport the HUD panel appears in. See [enum Corner] for valid values.
How often the HUD refreshes its statistics, in seconds. Lower values provide more responsive readouts at a small CPU cost. Clamped to the range [code]0.016[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
Size of the HUD text in pixels. Clamped to the range [code]8[/code] to [code]32[/code].
Background color of the HUD panel. Adjust the alpha component to control transparency.
